name: Talos
body:
Talos
CR 18/MR 6

This bronze automaton stands as tall as a building. Its heavy footfalls shake the ground with bone-jarring force.

XP 153,600
N Colossal construct (mythic)
Init –2; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, mistsight, see invisibility; Perception +18

DEFENSE

AC 36, touch 4, flat-footed 36 (–2 Dex, +32 natural, –4 size)
hp 230 (20d10+120)
Fort +6, Ref +4, Will +6
Defensive Abilities invincible guardianma; DR 15/adamantine and epic; Immune construct traits, fire, magic

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee 2 slams +34 (12d6+33/17–20/×3 plus 2d6 fire)
Space 30 ft.; Reach 30 ft.
Special Attacks breath weapon, destroyer, mythic power (6/day, surge +1d8), powerful blows, sweeping strike

STATISTICS

Str 54, Dex 7, Con —, Int 6, Wis 11, Cha 1
Base Atk +20; CMB +42 (+46 sunder); CMD 48 (52 vs. sunder)
Feats Critical FocusMF, Greater Sunder, Improved Critical (slam) MF, Improved Natural Attack (slam), Improved Sunder, Power AttackMF, Sundering Strike, Staggering Critical, Stunning Critical
Skills Perception +18
Languages Common (cannot speak)
SQ awakened construct, statue

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Awakened Construct (Ex)

A talos is a sentient being, awakened in the process of its creation, and can understand the language of its creator.

Breath Weapon (Su)

As a free action once every 1d3 rounds, a talos can exhale a noxious cloud of pyroclastic vapors in a 20-foot-radius spread, 40-foot cone, or 60-foot line. This gas functions as both cloudkill (DC 22) and incendiary cloud (DC 22) in the area, save that it is stationary and the cloud persists for 1d4 rounds. It can enhance the toxic effect to be equivalent to mythic cloudkill by expending one use of mythic power, or augmented mythic cloudkill if it expends two uses. The gas lasts only 1 round. The save DC is Constitution-based and includes a +2 racial bonus.

Death Throes (Ex)

A talos explodes when it is destroyed. All creatures within 30 feet of the talos take 20d6 points of fire damage (DC 20 Reflex for half). The save DC is Constitution-based.

Destroyer (Ex)

Whenever a talos attacks an object, including a held or worn item, it ignores any hardness the object might possess. This includes spell effects such as wall of force, but not objects that are also creatures, such as animated objects.

Immunity to Magic (Ex)

A talos is immune to spells or spell-like abilities that allow spell resistance. Certain spells and effects function differently against it, as noted below.

A mythic magical attack that deals cold damage slows a talos (as the slow spell) for 1d4 rounds, with no saving throw. A non-mythic magical attack that deals cold damage has the same effect but the golem is treated as though it has an SR of 30 against the effect that allows spell resistance.

A magical attack that deals fire damage breaks any slow effect on the talos and heals 1 point of damage for each 3 points of damage the attack would otherwise deal. If the amount of healing would cause the talos to exceed its full normal hit points, it gains any excess as temporary hit points. A talos gets no saving throw against fire effects.

A talos is affected normally by mythic rust attacks, such as those of a mythic rust monster or a mythic rusting grasp spell.

A non-mythic rust attack has the same effect but the golem is treated as though it has an SR of 30 against the effect that must first be overcome. Creatures that employ rust attacks that are not spells use their HD in place of their level when making the caster level check.

Invincible Guardian (Su)

A talos can expend one use of its mythic power as a swift action to make itself nearly invincible for a short period of time. The mythic talos’s existing DR doubles to DR 30/adamantine and epic, and it gains DR 15/— for a number of rounds equal to its mythic rank. This DR cannot be bypassed by abilities that normally bypass damage reduction unless the attacker is a mythic creature whose rank or tier exceeds that of the talos.

Powerful Blows (Ex)

A talos golem inflicts one and a half times its Strength modifier and threatens a critical hit on a 19–20 with its slam attacks.

Statue (Ex)

A talos can stand perfectly still, emulating a statue. An observer who takes time to examine the golem must succeed at a DC 20 Perception check to notice it is alive. If a talos initiates combat from this pose, it gains a +6 bonus on its initiative check.

Sweeping Strike (Su)

Whenever a talos could make a full attack, it may instead make a single attack at its highest attack bonus and apply the results to all opponents within its reach. Roll damage once and apply it to all opponents hit by the attack. If the attack roll is a critical threat, the mythic iron golem chooses one target hit by its sweeping strike and attempts to confirm the critical against that target.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary (unique)
Treasure none

This towering automaton of verdigrised bronze moves with an implacable tread, shaking the earth with every step.

He resembles a mighty armored warrior with breastplate, greaves, and crested helm, wielding a mighty blade welded into its closed fist. Its cast visage and hollow eyeholes give it a pitiless aspect when it rises to move, its metallic thews creaking and groaning with impossible strength. Each talos possesses a spark of divinity, said to have been imbued by the gods themselves, and their inmost workings roar with heat like a furnace as molten metal surges within it.
